base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl wget unzip openjdk-17-jdk libstdc++6 libncurses5 libbz2-1.0 libzstd1
setup_runtime_commands: curl -fsSL --max-time 900 https://dl.google.com/android/repository/android-ndk-r26b-linux.zip -o /tmp/ndk.zip || echo 'NDK download skipped - install separately if needed'
if [ -f /tmp/ndk.zip ]; then mkdir -p /opt/android-sdk/ndk/26.1.10909125 && unzip -q /tmp/ndk.zip -d /opt/android-sdk/ndk/26.1.10909125/ && rm /tmp/ndk.zip; fi
activation_command: export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64 && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH && export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk && export GRADLE_USER_HOME=/opt/gradle && export PATH=/opt/gradle/gradle-8.6/bin:$PATH

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: gradle handles test dependencies via build.gradle.kts
runtime_profile.notes: Android project requiring JDK 17, Android SDK 34, Build Tools 29.0.3, and NDK 26.1.10909125. Uses Gradle 8.6 wrapper. Unit tests run via ./gradlew testReleaseUnitTest. NDK is optional for unit tests but required for native builds.

notes: This is an Android application (Mihon manga reader) that builds on Linux. The CI workflow confirms compatibility with ubuntu-latest. git and curl are explicitly installed as baseline packages. The project uses Gradle wrapper (8.6) for builds. Android SDK is installed via direct downloads for reliability. The fix changes Instant.now().toEpochMilli() to Instant.now().epochSecond in ImageSaver.kt. NDK 26.1.10909125 download may timeout due to size (~1GB) - script handles gracefully with fallback instructions.
